Description

AIOTY-CUBE mission is a 12U CubeSat with sufficient payload volume and power along with high-speed data downlink. This makes AIOTY-CUBE ideal for payloads ranging from Artificial Intelligence (AI) or Internet of things (IoT) based experiments to space debris detection and removal.

The AIOTY-CUBE nanosatellite is based on RapidCube-20 platform with the purpose to demonstrate innovative scientific experiments. It is a joint mission between TU Berlin and Rapid Cubes GmbH. While this platform could be configured as 12U or 16U, AIOTY-CUBE nanosatellite is a 12U platfrom. The AIOTY-CUBE nanosatellite is scheduled to launch in 2024.

The experiments which are hosted within AIOTY-CUBE mission are:

  • LIZARD experiment
  • ATOMIC experiment
  • AI computer and a camera
  • mioty® radio receiver
  • Reaction wheel
Notes

The size changed from 16U to 12U.
